sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "company_settings" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "company_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'КФХ', "director_name" TEXT NULL, "inn" TEXT NULL, "ogrn" TEXT NULL, "bank_account" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "legal_address" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "default_work_day_hours" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 8.0, "overtime_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.5, "night_shift_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.2, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employees" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" TEXT NOT NULL, "hire_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "dismissal_date" TEXT NULL, "base_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "field_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employee_rates" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "base_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "field_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timesheet" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'work', "days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "work_place" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "payment_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "payment_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'salary', "period_start" TEXT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "document_number" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sick_leave" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_number" TEXT NULL, "days_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_by_employer" REAL NULL, "paid_by_fss" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vacation" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "vacation_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'annual', "days_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_approved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_approved" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_results" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "field_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sick_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vacation_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_salary" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "base_rate_used" REAL NULL, "field_rate_used" REAL NULL, "calculated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'calculated', "skipped_work_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_directions" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "overhead" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("overhead" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_allocation_keys" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_allocation_periods" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "key_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fin_allocation_keys (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "valid_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "shares" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_accounts" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_date" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "closed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closed" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_assets" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "reference_value" INTEGER NULL, "valued_on" TEXT NULL, "direction_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_directions (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "allocation_key_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_allocation_keys (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "cadastral_number" TEXT NULL, "area_ha" REAL NULL, "cadastral_value" INTEGER NULL, "disposed_on" TEXT NULL, "disposal_reason" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_category_groups" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_categories" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_directions (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "allocation_key_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_allocation_keys (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current', "in_tax_book" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("in_tax_book" IN (0, 1)), "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "group_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_category_groups (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "counterparties" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "inn" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_debts" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "counterparty_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES counterparties (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_date" TEXT NULL, "closed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closed" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_operations" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fin_accounts (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "to_account_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_accounts (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "category_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_categories (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "direction_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_directions (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "allocation_key_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_allocation_keys (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "asset_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_assets (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "season" INTEGER NULL, "counterparty_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES counterparties (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "employee_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "debt_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_debts (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "debt_move" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "tag" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_payroll_mapping" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "target_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_adjustments" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fin_plans" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "until_date" TEXT NULL, "account_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_accounts (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "category_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fin_categories (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "counterparty_uuid" TEXT NULL REFERENCES counterparties (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "description" TEXT NULL, "skipped" TEXT NULL, "closed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));
